name: Party experience
description: Party members that did not fight in a won battle still get experience: a share of what one fighter got. The fighters' experience, the money and the techniques' experience are unchanged. Only the three Digimon in the party gain; the others at the lab do not.

options.name: Share for members that did not fight (%)
options.description: Percent of one fighter's experience. 100: as much as a fighter; 0: nothing.

options.name: Knocked-out members get the share too
options.description: A member knocked out when the battle ends gets nothing in the game. On: it gets the same share as a member that did not fight.

options.name: Catch-up bonus
options.description: A member below the party's highest level gets 10% more experience per level below it, at most twice as much. Applies to fighters too.
